metadata.title: Decree of the Chairman of the Egyptian Drug Authority No. 354 of 2026 on implementing Good Pharmacovigilance Practice
metadata.edition: Decree No. 354/2026 · 24 June 2026, in effect from issue · Articles 1, 3 to 5 (English text machine-garbled)
metadata.legal_basis: EDA Chairman decree adopting the GVP guideline; the official Arabic text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
Candidates are not approved requirements. Read the original, qualifications and exceptions.
Scans, tables, other languages and implicit obligations may be missed. Zero candidates does not establish zero requirements.

candidates.statement: - Having considered the interest of work; (Article 1) (Article 1) This decision shall be implemented with respect to theApplying of Good pharmacovigilance practice (GVP) in Egypt.
candidates.context: -Material presented by the Head of the Central Administration of Pharmaceutical Care; (Article 2) (Article 2) The General Administration of Pharmaceutical vigilance (Egyptian Pharmacovigilance Center ) detects, receives, reviews, analyzes and assesses case safety reports, evaluation and inspection of the pharmacovigilance system of the companies and Marketing authorization holders of the Pharmaceutical and Biological products, monitoring of safety signals for products, assessment of the benefit risk evaluation reports, risk management plans, and all related pharmacovigi - lance activities.

candidates.statement: (Article 3) (Article 3) Pharmaceutical and biological product companies and Marketing authorization holders shall establish a pharmacovigilance system and implement its concerned activities to monitor the safety of their products and report safety information to the General Administration of Phar- macovigilance. They shall also appoint a qualified person responsible for the pharmacovigi - lance system within the company, in accordance with the regulatory guidelines of that decree and other related regulatory guideline issued by the General Administration of Pharmacovig- ilance.
